evidence: 2026-10-31: official https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/main/templates/video_minimax_h3_t2v.json, converted to API format by the ComfyUI 0.43.0 frontend (app.graphToPrompt). Changes: video VAE mapped to the installed fp16 file and the turbo LoRA to its 768p release (same model families), turbo on by default, example prompt emptied.

2026-10-31: Sharpen 2x stage added (MiniMax H3 latent upscaler, native ComfyUI node from PR 17412, then 3 refine steps from sigma 0.9035 with the turbo model and the same conditioning), the same stage as previs-to-video; a lazy switch runs it only when on.
